campaign.title: Signed incidence ledger at actual alpha floor, star, profile, and radial seams

resource_policy.literature_policy: No external theorem is needed for the finite incidence algebra. Search only if the surviving coefficient becomes a named singular-integral or jump-cancellation form.

frozen_target.question: At one actual logarithmic discontinuity of the alpha amplitude, does the complete signed terminal/connector/face/axis/corner/Plemelj incidence coefficient cancel identically, or what is the first nonzero survivor?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Start from the Round-50 coupled multiplier m_lambda(beta)=(1-psi(beta))psi(beta+lambda) and the common finite endpoint-free alpha antecedent. Model one actual seam by W(L)=W_-(L)+Delta_W S^*_(L0)(L), keep the exact top Plemelj identity (0^++i mu)^(-1)=pi delta_0(mu)-i PV(1/mu), and apply the full finite Cauchy-Pompeiu/product outside-axis ledger before any limit or absolute value.
quantities: one actual seam type at a time: H_j floor, product star, dyadic profile edge, or radial endpoint
A-strip area connector or both sharp edges
oriented u/v faces and positive axes
connector-face, connector-axis, mixed connector, and one corner
signed top delta plus principal value
common E1/R1 artificial-pole and A=0 ownership exclusions
exact jump coefficient and one-count external normalization

completion_criteria: The logarithmic seam variable and jump coefficient are defined from an actual profile/floor/star/radial factor, not an arbitrary surrogate.
Every finite terminal, connector, face, axis, mixed, corner, delta, and PV incidence is listed once with orientation.
A=0 arithmetic, artificial rho=0, log-kernel delta, lattice delta, and Plemelj delta remain distinct owners.
The total singular jump coefficient is proved zero or an explicit nonzero survivor is derived.
Any cancellation is tested at equality stars and moving finite faces and before outside-height limits.
The resulting local statement is connected to, but not confused with, the global X^(1/8) and height capacities.
A clean statement-only derivation and independent hostile audit exist.
No global alpha or downstream estimate is promoted from local incidence alone.

tasks.target: Construct the complete finite signed incidence table for one representative actual seam in each class, calculate the total singular jump coefficient, and prove cancellation or isolate the first survivor.
Independently derive the finite signed seam incidence from the frozen packet and decide whether the singular coefficient cancels, without consulting graph or claimant work.

Hostile-audit the local incidence for omitted moving-boundary distributions, sign errors, conflated deltas, equality-star half weights, false rowwise connector cancellation, and illicit promotion from local to global estimates.

review_seams.requirement: List every stratum incident to one actual jump and its exact orientation.
Separate arithmetic, log-kernel, lattice, and Plemelj distributions and retain equality stars.
Evaluate the complete signed singular coefficient before absolute values or limits.
Distinguish local seam cancellation from global height and arithmetic summation.
The blind proof sees only the Round-51 packet and its brief.
